latestVersion.changelog:
AI Video Editor Best — Initial Release

- Instantly edit and export polished videos by uploading raw footage and providing natural-language instructions.
- Supports MP4, MOV, AVI, and WebM formats up to 500MB, with export in 1080p MP4.
- Automated cloud-based editing pipeline handles trimming, transitions, text, audio, and more for content creators and marketers.
- Handles authentication and session management automatically (including anonymous free starter token if needed).
- User prompts are intelligently routed to actions (edit, export, show credits, check status, or upload).
- Provides clear workflow guidance, live status updates, and straightforward download links for finished videos.
